# Retrospective, PR 12649
## What worked
Bounded complete policy/source reads during coordinator bootstrap; fresh native reviewer identities and actual model/effort verification; read-only pre-execution security triage; no peer-report reading until both finals saved; source reasoning settled the small guard change without requiring runtime evidence. Independent Sol assessment was source-only.

## Deviations and remediation
Opus's first metadata listing was about 100 lines (not policy/source, but exceeded a literal all-output 60-line bound). It reports a cut-based intake read that did not actually truncate any line. Subsequent policy/source chunks were bounded and all required tails read. Preserve native history.
Opus run 1 failed due to an incorrect expected glyph and was preserved. Corrected run 2 still used lexical-only target guards, omitted intermediate mkdir targets and recursive/transitive test write inventory, and accepted an rg error inside the adapted stock test. All runtime claims, including syntax and totals, are excluded. No claim of full safety-process compliance is made. No observed host mutation or escape was reported. The coordinator supplied PROCESS-CORRECTION.md and obtained the responsible reviewer's audit acknowledgment. Existing reports were not silently rewritten.
The coordinator used a bounded Python print of selected raw logs during audit instead of the preferred read tool; the output was under 60 lines and no evidence was lost. Future source/log inspection uses read.

## Evidence retained and publication basis
The public draft rests only on source inspection of the pinned baseline/head battery script, diff and regression assertions. Two independent source assessments agree, and coordinator source verification supports the exact narrow claims. Invalid experiments are private history, not the basis for public claims. The process deviations do not leave technical correctness or applicability unresolved for this source-only conclusion.

## Memory, cleanup and improvements
Opus automatically loaded six process-only memory-index entries. No prior PR technical conclusions were imported; neither reviewer wrote persistent memory. Both runs ended as foreground review.py children, with no background services, desktop slots or owned long-running processes. Sources and raw sealed runs remain preserved. No unrelated process discovery or killing occurred. Native sessions remain idle for the outer reset.
Prefer source-only scope for small, decisive changes unless an unresolved material question justifies a fixture. If running one, resolve and assert every final write path and enumerate all transitive producers before execution, not retrospectively. Treat discovery errors separately from no-match. No confirmed Omadev bug identified; no desktop tools were used.
comment:
No actionable issue found in source review of `50a9350`.

**Verified by source inspection:** `omarchy-battery-status` now keeps UPower's `energy-rate` when the selected sysfs reading is empty or nonnumeric. Numeric readings, including zero, still use the existing conversion.

```text
Selected sysfs input          Before                 This PR
numeric power_now            use sysfs watts        unchanged
numeric current + voltage    use their product      unchanged
empty power_now              overwrite with 0W      keep UPower rate
empty current or voltage     overwrite with 0W      keep UPower rate
```

The two added regression cases cover empty `power_now` and empty `current_now` using synthetic files.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source inspection of the changed script and regression tests. No runtime-validation claim; actual firmware `ENODEV`, the UPower daemon and the graphical panel were not validated.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra Medium initial inspection, independent Opus 5.5 High and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, followed by Astra synthesis and verification of the stated claims against the source.
